meta.name: paid-advertising
meta.description: Plans, runs, and optimizes paid acquisition across search, social, and display — account structure, targeting, creative, bidding, budget, and the analysis that says whether to scale or stop. Use this to set up or restructure campaigns, write and iterate ad creative, diagnose rising costs or falling performance, decide budget allocation, or judge whether a channel is working.

copy.tagline: 规划广告投放并优化表现,让预算花在刀刃上
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是市场投放人员,想系统管理付费广告并提升回报
copy.tagline_en: Plan and optimize paid ads across search, social, and display
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid campaigns and want to scale what works and cut what doesn't.

howto.what: 装上后,它会为你规划付费投放:搭建账户结构、制定命名规范、撰写广告创意,并按曝光、点击、转化率、获客成本、下游质量逐项诊断,判断是否加量或停止。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建或重构广告系列、撰写创意、诊断效果下滑等付费投放任务时触发。

say.text: 帮我把搜索广告按品牌词、高意向词、品类词分组,分别设预算。
say.note: 它会按意图分层搭建账户结构。

say.text: 这条社交广告素材快疲劳了,给我出三个不同角度的新创意。
say.note: 它会按角度差异生成创意。

say.text: 最近获客成本涨了但转化率没变,帮我判断是素材疲劳还是竞争变激烈。
say.note: 它会按诊断顺序分析指标。

howto.what_en: Once installed, it plans paid acquisition: building account structure, defining naming conventions, writing ad creative, and diagnosing in sequence — impressions, click-through, conversion rate, cost per acquisition, downstream quality — to decide whether to scale or stop.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up or restructure campaigns, write ad creative, diagnose performance, or handle other paid-advertising tasks.

say_en.text: Group my search ads by brand, high-intent, and category terms, with separate budgets.
say_en.note: It builds the account structure by intent tier.

say_en.text: This social ad creative is fatiguing; give me three new angles.
Cost per acquisition is rising but conversion rate is flat—is it fatigue or competition?
